selection: Primary: largest minimum leave-one-validation-year-out Sharpe improvement over fixed50; secondary: largest aggregate validation Sharpe. Keep fixed50 as the preferred policy unless a learner improves aggregate validation Sharpe. Freeze both selections before later replay.
later_evaluation: Evaluate the validation winner within each feature group, plus the two overall selectors. Retain all validation attempts and all later results; no post-test replacement of the primary.
evaluation_status: Exploratory research on previously inspected dates, not a new untouched holdout.

q_study.later_evaluation: For each task/frequency/state group: validation-robust and validation-point winners, their gamma-zero controls, all constant actions, a trailing-performance rule, and three predeclared random-action controls. Evaluate costs x2 and x5 for the primary and validation-best constant.
q_study.scope: Fitted Q over fractional, funded strategy indices, with drifting prior allocations and next-close resizing costs. Not a jointly funded option-inventory replay.
